title: The conditions of the religion (din)
intro: Din means religion, and shart means condition. There are 33 conditions of the religion.

learn.html: Din means religion, and shart means condition. The conditions of the religion are the conditions or actions every adult must fulfil for complete faith. There are thirty-three of them:

learn.title: Ihsan
learn.html: Ihsan is the highest level of awareness of Allah, the Most High – as if we see Him, because even if we do not see Him, He sees us. This belief helps us keep fulfilling the conditions of the religion.

questions.q: How many conditions of the religion are there?
How many conditions of Salah are there?

options: Worshipping Allah as if we see Him, knowing He sees us
